items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: I did several recording dates with him.

ctx.x: Oh yes, it was beautiful. I just didn't realize that it was making all that noise until it did. Until it really did.

Tell you what, let's go back about 20 years before that and pick up. Before we even do--I was going to ask you about Frankie Newton, but while we were taking a break, you mentioned about Snake Hips Tucker. Would you mind putting that on tape, it's a nice story.
